title: E0025: Lines of Code per File
plain_english: Reports files that exceed the configured total line-count threshold.
why_matters: Very large files are harder to navigate and often contain too many responsibilities. Smaller files with clear boundaries are usually easier to review and maintain.
bad_example:
<?php

namespace App;

class OrderManager
{
    // 300 lines of order logic...
    // 200 lines of billing logic...
    // 150 lines of shipping logic...
}
what_it_checks: Applies to files containing a class, trait, enum, or interface declaration.
Counts every line in the file (`file.lines.len()`).
Reports when the total line count is greater than `max_loc`.
